title: LLM logprob comparators: Llama, Qwen and Gemma via option-token logprobs
description: The slow-thinking comparator without an API bill: transformers last-token logits on every device, mlx-lm logprobs on Mac, llama.cpp n_probs for one GGUF across Metal, CPU and CUDA. Qwen is the Chinese-trained comparator the nationality axis of batch 2 needs.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: LLM logprob comparators answer via option-token logprobs

Scenario: Llama, Qwen and Gemma each work as a bill-free slow-thinking comparator
  Given transformers last-token logits, mlx-lm logprobs on Mac, and llama.cpp n_probs for one GGUF, and Qwen selected as the Chinese-trained comparator batch 2's nationality axis needs
  When I run bd run --engine llama|qwen|gemma --comparator logprob on a committed task
  Then each comparator returns an option probability derived from token logprobs for every item, with no API bill, and studies/ records the answers

right_now_summary: The feature adds bill-free logprob comparisons for Llama, Qwen, and Gemma across major runtimes.
